g.text: │ OPENROUTER_API_KEY is set; default model: none; roles using api need │
│ Codex reports no cost, so its attempts count $0 toward the [budget] caps; │
│ │ │ they are bounded only by max_task_attempts and timeout_s. Set a spend limit │
│ on (cli setting); profile textstats (repo, 6 lesson(s)); each run ends with │
│ prefer_free off; 6 free model(s) cached, fetched 0.0h ago; roles using free │
│ free models: providers serving them may log prompts or train on them; your │
│ │ │ which providers may be used, separately for free and paid models. Prompts │
│ │ │ include your idea, plan and diffs. │
│ the api worker gets no tools │
│ read-only role with MCP servers (github, docs): it can do whatever those │
│ │ │ servers allow, writes included; see docs/security.md │
